scope: C4-C precondition audit for stale/mismatch, R4 numeric-fault, and reset cases in the existing C3b same-instance harness; no RTL or capture change is made.

cases.name: stale_r1_read_response
cases.same_instance_evidence: RouteARTL265a2PackReadPublicationSpec delivers payloadRequestId + 1 while S2 remains FILLING.
cases.boundary: No stale response may mutate S2, produce a terminal, or advance reclamation.

cases.name: stale_or_mismatched_r4_completion
cases.ingress: io.c3_r4_result or io.c3_r4_numeric_fault with wrong request/incarnation/consumer, or simultaneous result and fault
cases.same_instance_evidence: The C3b harness routes both inputs through RouteAFunctionalR4ReferenceBoundary and RouteAMergeBoundary; their focused tests reject stale identity and simultaneous terminal kinds.
cases.boundary: No mismatched R4 input may consume the outstanding merge or manufacture a terminal.

cases.name: matching_r4_numeric_fault
cases.same_instance_evidence: C3b exposes the exact outer functional R4 fault input through c3R4Reference and c3Merge to lifecycle.merge_terminal_in.
cases.boundary: One matching fault terminal is permitted; no success terminal replay, runtime retirement, R5 free observation, or R6 retire acknowledgement may follow.

cases.name: reset_while_selected_event_is_held
cases.ingress: harness reset asserted while a C4 event output is valid and ready-low
cases.same_instance_evidence: The C3b harness has the same reset domain as R3/R5/R6/S2 and every C4 observer is zero-buffer/combinational; the existing C2 witness resets a READY S2 slot to EMPTY.
cases.boundary: Reset clears a held, unaccepted observation and cannot replay it or create a new event without reinitialization and a new owner-accepted path.

required_c4_c_checks: Snapshot every selected event fire, not merely valid, and compare against the case's allowed prefix/suffix.
For each rejected stale/mismatch ingress, prove its ready is low or that it has no downstream state effect before inspecting C4 outputs.
For matching numeric fault, prove exactly one FAULT terminal and no later success terminal, page_free, or retire_ack.
For reset, hold a selected event ready-low, assert reset, and prove all four event outputs remain invalid until a fresh initialized path is driven.
forbidden: treat a valid-only signal as an accepted event
add a retry or Full-KV fallback
